review: 702.178a-2: setup did not fix that the once-per-turn speed trigger was still available; added to notes.
702.178b-1: speed_4_on_battlefield expected carried reasoning; reduced to the observable verdict.

scenarios.title: A max speed ability applies only while its controller's speed is 4

setup.notes: A's speed is 4 (max speed). B has no speed. Gastal Raider (2/1) has 'Max speed - This creature gets +1/+1 and has menace.' Nothing is cast or activated; the board is read after state-based actions.

decisions: No spells or abilities are used; the continuous effects on A's battlefield are read.

variants.label: speed_4
variants.expected: Gastal Raider is a 3/2 with menace.

variants.label: speed_3
variants.expected: Gastal Raider is a 2/1 without menace.

operation.unclassifiable: not a board edit: A's speed is 3 instead of 4; player speed is a property no operation sets.

detector.outcome: A max speed static contributes its power/toughness boost while its controller's speed is 4.
detector.near_miss: The max speed static applies to the board and contributes nothing (speed below 4).

scenarios.title: Reaching speed 4 turns the max speed ability on

setup.notes: A's speed is 3. B has no speed. Gastal Raider (2/1) has 'Max speed - This creature gets +1/+1 and has menace.' A's speed has not increased yet this turn.

decisions: A casts Shock targeting player B, tapping Mountain.
Both players pass; Shock resolves, and the speed trigger resolves if it triggered.

variants.label: opponent_loses_life
variants.expected: B loses 2 life (life 18). A's speed becomes 4 and Gastal Raider is a 3/2 with menace.

variants.label: creature_target
variants.delta: Shock targets B's Grizzly Bears instead of player B.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears is dealt 2 damage and moves to B's graveyard. B's life stays 20. A's speed stays 3 and Gastal Raider is a 2/1 without menace.

operation.unclassifiable: target: Shock targets B's Grizzly Bears instead of player B.

detector.outcome: A max speed static starts contributing once its controller's speed reaches 4.
detector.near_miss: The max speed static applies to the board and contributes nothing (speed below 4).

scenarios.title: A granted ability that names the graveyard works only from the graveyard

setup.notes: A's speed is 4. Goblin Surveyor has 'Max speed - {3}, Exile this card from your graveyard: Draw a card.', an ability granted by its max speed ability that functions from the graveyard.

decisions: A activates the graveyard ability of Goblin Surveyor, paying {3} with three Mountains and exiling Goblin Surveyor from the graveyard.
Both players pass; the ability resolves.

variants.label: speed_4_in_graveyard
variants.expected: The activation is legal. Goblin Surveyor moves from A's graveyard to exile as a cost. The ability resolves and A draws Forest.

variants.label: speed_3_in_graveyard
variants.expected: The activation is not legal: Goblin Surveyor has no such ability. It stays in A's graveyard and A's hand stays empty.

operation.unclassifiable: not a board edit: A's speed is 3 instead of 4; player speed is a property no operation sets.

variants.label: speed_4_on_battlefield
variants.delta: Goblin Surveyor is on A's battlefield instead of in A's graveyard.
variants.expected: The activation is not legal. Goblin Surveyor stays on the battlefield and A's hand stays empty.

operation.unclassifiable: more than one fact: Goblin Surveyor leaves A's graveyard (out of move_card's reach to the battlefield) and is added as a permanent (add_permanent).

scenarios.forge_notes: Variant speed_4_on_battlefield moves the card from the graveyard to the battlefield, so A's graveyard is empty in that variant.

detector.outcome: A candidate ability that states it functions from a zone other than the battlefield passes the zone check while its card is in that zone.
detector.near_miss: A candidate ability activated from a zone it does not function from fails the zone check.
